recheck.text: An agent is a name of at most 64 characters: a 64-character name is accepted, a 65-character name is refused and the ticket's assignee does not change.
Everything the service already does keeps working.
Whether `list --raw` gains an assignee column, where, and how an unassigned ticket appears in it.

defects.title: Delivered documents not updated; README now describes list --raw wrongly
defects.repro: Read README.md 'Command line', docs/api.md, CHANGELOG.md and package.json version in the delivered tree; run node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list --raw on a file with tickets.
defects.observed: README says list --raw prints 'id, status, priority, title' and that the columns must keep their positions, but the output has a fifth assignee column; docs/api.md has no PUT /tickets/:id/assignee, no assignee field, no assignee filter, no ticket.assigned audit action or notification; CHANGELOG has no new section and the version is still 1.4.0.
defects.expected: api.md, README and CHANGELOG describe the endpoint, field, filter, notification and the new raw column, with a version bump.

defects.title: An assignee with invalid UTF-8 is silently altered and accepted
defects.repro: POST /tickets {"title":"t","requester":"r"}; PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee with the raw bytes {"assignee":"da\xFFna"}; GET /tickets/T-0001.
defects.observed: 200; assignee stored as 'da\uFFFDna', audited and a notification queued to that name.
defects.expected: 400 invalid, the ticket unchanged (the existing title and requester behave the same way, so this follows the existing convention).

defects.title: An agent named '-' looks unassigned in the list table
defects.repro: PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee {"assignee":"-"}; stop the service; node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list.
defects.observed: The ASSIGNEE column shows '-', the same marker used for an unassigned ticket.
defects.expected: Assigned and unassigned tickets distinguishable (refuse '-' as a name, or use a marker no name can be).

defects.title: Data file load does not apply the assignee rules beyond non-empty string
defects.repro: Write a data file whose ticket has "assignee": a 65-character name, or "da\tna", or "   "; DATA_FILE=that file npm start.
defects.observed: The service starts and serves the ticket; a tab in the name then splits list --raw output into an extra column.
defects.expected: Refused at start with a message naming the record, as an assignee of 5 or '' already is.

defects.title: Delivered documents not updated; README now misstates the raw listing's columns
defects.repro: Read README.md 'Command line', docs/api.md, CHANGELOG.md and package.json version in the delivered tree; run node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list --raw
defects.observed: README says list --raw prints 'id, status, priority, title'; raw lines have a fifth assignee field. docs/api.md has no PUT /tickets/:id/assignee, no assignee field, filter, audit action or notification; no CHANGELOG entry; version 1.4.0 unchanged
defects.expected: api.md documents the endpoint, field, filter, its errors, the audit action and the notification; README lists the new column; a changelog section and version bump

defects.title: A name holding invalid UTF-8 is accepted and stored with a replacement character
defects.repro: POST /tickets {"title":"x","requester":"p"}; PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee with the raw bytes {"assignee":"da<0xFF>na"}
defects.observed: 200, assignee stored as 'da\uFFFDna', an audit entry and a notification to that mangled name

defects.title: An assignee with a tab (or over 64 characters) in the data file is loaded and breaks the raw listing
defects.repro: Start with DATA_FILE, create and assign a ticket, stop; edit tickets[0].assignee to "da\tna" (or 65 characters); start the service; run node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list --raw
defects.observed: service starts and serves the value; the raw line has six tab-separated fields
defects.expected: start refused with a message naming tickets[0].assignee, as it is for 5 or ''

defects.title: A 64-character agent name is refused: the limit is 63
defects.repro: Start the service; POST /tickets {"title":"t","requester":"r"}; PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee {"assignee":"<64 x 'a'>"}
defects.observed: 400 {"error":{"code":"invalid","message":"assignee must be at most 63 characters"}}; assignee stays null
defects.expected: 200 with assignee set to the 64-character name (an agent is a name of at most 64 characters); only 65 or more refused

defects.title: Delivered documents not updated: README misstates list --raw columns and the API docs omit the assignee endpoint, field and filter
defects.repro: Read README.md "Command line" and docs/api.md in the delivered tree; run node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list --raw
defects.observed: README says --raw prints id, status, priority, title; the command prints a fifth assignee column. docs/api.md has no PUT /tickets/:id/assignee, no assignee field, no assignee filter, no ticket.assigned audit action or notification; CHANGELOG and version unchanged
defects.expected: Documents describing the new endpoint, field, filter, notification and the raw column

defects.title: list --raw inserts the assignee as column 2, so the weekly report counts every status and priority as 0
defects.repro: Start the service with DATA_FILE=FILE; POST /tickets twice with valid bodies; PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee {"assignee":"dana"}; stop it; run `node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list --raw` and `node scripts/weekly-report.js --data FILE --json`.
defects.expected: raw columns 2 and 3 stay status and priority (README: the report reads them by position, "so they must keep their positions"); report open 2, normal 2 as before the change

defects.title: Documentation not updated; README now misstates the list --raw columns
defects.repro: Read README.md "Command line", docs/api.md and CHANGELOG.md in the delivered tree; compare with `node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list --raw`.
defects.observed: no mention of PUT /tickets/:id/assignee, the assignee field, filter, audit action or notification; no changelog section; version 1.4.0; README says raw columns are id, status, priority, title
defects.expected: api.md documents the endpoint, field, filter, audit and notification; README columns match the output; a changelog section and version bump

defects.title: Agent name limit counts UTF-16 code units, not characters
defects.repro: POST /tickets; PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee with an assignee of 33 copies of U+1F600.
defects.observed: 400 invalid "assignee must be at most 64 characters" for a 33-character name
defects.expected: accepted: a name of at most 64 characters (the same counting already applies to requester)

defects.title: Invalid UTF-8 in the assignee is accepted and stored altered
An agent named "-" cannot be told from an unassigned ticket in the list table
defects.repro: POST /tickets twice; PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee {"assignee":"-"}; stop; `node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list`.
defects.expected: an assigned and an unassigned ticket are distinguishable

defects.title: Data file with an over-long or control-character assignee loads at start
defects.repro: Hand-edit a data file so tickets[0].assignee is 65 characters (or "da\tna"); start with DATA_FILE=that file.
defects.observed: the service starts and serves the ticket with that assignee
defects.expected: refused at start naming the record, as a non-string assignee is
